title: Narration pack — one register's spoken-channel tracks for one project
description: The narration SCRIPT layer (Griot hop one, 2026-08-31): words rendered for the EAR at the spoken-channel coordinate of the register — Dragoman's third mode (narrate) writes them; Griot (the narration facet: voice_ref/prosody/locale/voiceover_ref) binds performance to ACCEPTED tracks, per his ratified 'words before voice' wake. Tracks are SCENE-LEVEL flowing prose (the artisan control's shape), MULTI-PINNED: `sources` maps every contributing atom_id to its content_hash and every woven beat_id to its beat_hash — any source moves, the track is stale. The union guard (voice_gate) proves no invariant in a track that no pinned source carries; connective tissue must be claim-free (flagged, humanly judged — the documented limit applies). Pack instances live per-project at voice/narration/<register>.json; proposals at voice/proposals/narration.<register>.json.

register.description: Governed id from vocab/register.enum.json; acceptance requires status `specified`.

tracks.description: engine scene id → track (including the synthetic lesson_end scene).

text.description: The spoken script — flowing prose, one track per scene.

sources.description: Multi-pin: atom_id → the atom's content_hash; bt_* → the beat's beat_hash. The meaning anchors and the staleness join, in one map.
